references.text: This is a direct parallel that confirms the identity of Esau's sons Eliphaz and Reuel as well as their mothers Ada and Basemath.
This text confirms and expands the list of Esau's sons found in Genesis, showing how Chronicles systematizes Edom's history.
This verse elaborates on the lineage by listing Reuel's (Esau's son) own sons and chiefs, completing the picture of the Esau family.
